supp_diagnostics.coding_losses.caption: source record SRC-S37. Conditional M? prediction among recorded damage reports
supp_diagnostics.coding_losses.note: Main-text link: Section 5.5, calibration transfer failure limits fitted subtype predictions. National test is 2024–2025; targets are 2015–2025. Every row concerns known damage reports only. The constant is 236/287 from national 2023 damage reports. Expected M? sums conditional coding probabilities over damaged reports. Losses are absolute values in original units. All three versions remain visible because calibration changed transfer performance; no target outcomes fitted or calibrated the model. These are descriptive fixed-prediction scores, without sampling or development intervals. period_model_scores.csv gives all fifteen full-precision population-period-reference records.

supp_diagnostics.coding_periods.caption: source record SRC-S37B. Conditional coding performance by target calendar period
supp_diagnostics.coding_periods.note: Main-text link: Section 5.5, coding-model transfer limits fitted subtype predictions. Within each period, aligned lines give calibrated EB, uncalibrated EB and the national 2023 constant. All versions use identical target damage reports; the three periods sum to 309 reports and 252 M? outcomes. Both fitted versions share coefficients, with only one applying the national 2023 transformation. Targets are excluded from fitting and calibration. Lower losses indicate better predictions. These exploratory fixed-model scores have no sampling or development intervals and do not select a preferred calibration strategy. source record SRC-S37 gives overall scores; period_model_scores.csv retains full precision.
